Detailed Description

A UGenInternal base that is "releasable" in the sense of a envelope which may be released.

This means it should also be "stealable" i.e., told to stop immediately, or at least very quickly. This is normally for envelopes which may have a sustain section (e.g., ASR or EnvGen using a sustaining Env).
